title: Semantius Copilot agent configuration (agent.jsonc)
description: Per-agent config in agents/<name>/agent.jsonc. The file is REQUIRED: folders without it are skipped by the bundler. Skills live in agents/<name>/skills/<skill>/; an optional INSTRUCTIONS.md next to the config is appended to `instructions`, and an optional welcome.jsonc holds the welcome card instead of the `welcome` key. This schema mirrors validateAgentConfig in core/src/agent.js — change both together.

instructions.description: Agent instructions. An optional INSTRUCTIONS.md in the same folder is appended after this text. At least one of the two must yield non-empty instructions.

models.description: Model ids this agent may run on — keys of the model registry backend-b/agents_config.jsonc (which holds each model's provider, upstream id, limits and routing). The FIRST is the default for a new session; with more than one, the chat UI shows a model dropdown until the first message, after which the pick is fixed for the session. Deploy fails (422) on an id the deployed registry does not know.

proxy_whitelist.description: Egress allow list for this agent's sandbox. Each entry is a hostname ('www.semantius.com') or a URL ('https://api.acme.io/v1/*'), and may carry one or more '*' at any position — '*.semantius.ai' matches subdomains but not the bare apex; a bare '*' matches everything. Entries WITHOUT a path match the request's hostname only (port ignored); entries with a scheme and/or path match the request URL, and their paths are case-sensitive. This list is UNIONED at egress with the organization's own copilot allow list, so the effective policy can be wider than what stands here. DENY-ALL WHEN BOTH ARE ABSENT: an agent without this property (or with an empty list) whose org contributes nothing can make no outbound requests from its sandbox at all. One PLACEHOLDER is recognized: the exact entry '$SEMANTIUS_DATA_HOST' stands for the session org's own data host (the host of its postgrest_url, looked up when the session is created — where semantius CLI v0.8.9+ sends its data calls) and also lets the user's Semantius JWT travel to that one host; any other entry starting with '$' is rejected.

web_tools.description: OpenRouter server tools (e.g. { "type": "openrouter:web_search", "parameters": { ... } }, { "type": "openrouter:web_fetch", ... }). Every entry is appended VERBATIM to the request-body `tools` array of each model turn on an OpenRouter model — no field validation here, OpenRouter is the authority on its own tool shapes (an ill-formed entry fails the turn with OpenRouter's error). Ignored for openai-provider models. Capped at 16 entries / 16 KiB serialized.

welcome.description: Welcome card for the chat UI (schema: core/welcome.schema.json). Alternatively put it in agents/<name>/welcome.jsonc — not both.
